panels.description: Neighbors place credits on a communal table while Pilar keeps the clinic envelope beside her paper ledger. No recognizable crowd faces; leave upper table space.
The count reaches five hundred credits. Keep the amount unobstructed.
A payment terminal accepts the communal transfer. Leave upper terminal space.
Inside the mine, Alex's band updates to current installment and authorized rail crossing. Leave upper display space.
